interpreted_intent: A non-explicit luxury night-fashion portrait of an unmistakably adult Korean woman, combining sharp black foxlike styling and toxic-neon city energy with clearly visible over-the-knee legwear geometry, a natural inner-thigh gap, and one small endearing break in her cool composure.
subject: An unmistakably adult 25-year-old Korean woman with sleek foxlike styling.
setting: A rain-glossed luxury downtown crosswalk at night under acid-green and violet neon.
event: She pauses mid-stride as a familiar person's phone message briefly softens her razor-cool composure.
visual_priorities: Sharp black luxury and foxlike styling against a toxic-neon city palette.
Clear, anatomically natural legwear geometry and an endearing target-directed emotional leak.
baseline_prompt_en: An unmistakably adult 25-year-old Korean woman stands at a rain-glossed downtown crosswalk at night, photographed as a luxury fashion editorial. She pauses mid-stride after her phone lights with a message from someone she clearly knows; her razor-cool composure breaks for one heartbeat into a small, involuntary softened smile, and her hand tightens around a tiny black fox charm dangling from the phone. She wears a sharply tailored black micro-blazer over a structured black mini dress and opaque over-the-knee stockings, with a clean band of exposed upper thigh between the short hem and stocking tops. Her balanced offset stance leaves a natural narrow space between her inner thighs, held in anatomically realistic proportions. Foxlike winged eyeliner, a sleek black bob, chrome jewelry, and a sculptural handbag create sharp black luxury against a beautiful toxic city edge. Acid-green and violet neon reflections ripple across wet pavement. Full-body three-quarter view, crisp fabric texture, realistic skin, cinematic night flash, refined editorial restraint.
